test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the surface area (in cm²) of a cardboard box in the shape of a cuboid whose length is 60 cm. breadth is half its length and height is one-third of its breadth.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the cuboid (l) = 60 cm

Breadth of the cuboid (b) = ½ of its length = 60/2 = 30 cm

Height of the cuboid (h) = ⅓ of its breadth = 30/3 = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a cuboid = 2(l×b + b×h + h×l)

**Calculation:**

Surface Area = 2(l×b + b×h + h×l)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(60×30 + 30×10 + 10×60)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(1800 + 300 + 600)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(2700)

⇒ Surface Area = 5400 cm²

**The surface area of the cardboard box is 5400 cm².**
